snippet.title: Descent of Lunaris - Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Demo available on Steam! 

Check it out on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3824720/Descent_Of_Lunaris/

About the Demo/Prologue:
When an experiment at a secret facility goes terribly wrong, an elite security team is tasked with protecting the researchers as they prepare to evacuate. Reality breaking anomalies are warping the minds and bodies of some of the researchers, transforming them into monstrous mimics of their former selves. The elite team is given their orders to protect the evacuation but tears in reality and warped grotesque scientists are the least of their worries when a cosmic entity appears.

Once the prologue is complete, you will be briefed on the main mission and given full control to create your own level 1 party, assigning attributes and skills as you see fit. Once your team is ready and a leader is selected, you are free to explore the entire first level of the game. You can return to base to heal and change out team members as often as you want, try out different classes and skill combinations.


FEATURES:
Classic Dungeon Crawling - Explore the moon in this classic inspired grid-based dungeon crawling RPG. Customize your party at the moon base and explore the dungeon levels to find what lies in waiting beneath the surface.

Create Your Perfect Team - Customize your operatives' abilities, unlock new subclasses, change up your gear, and upgrade your characters to customize your play experience and tackle your enemies in a style that suits you.

Immersive First-Person Exploration - Travel through the world beneath the lunar surface and explore the dungeons to discover its secrets. Defeat powerful enemies to level up your team and gain access to new areas.

Dynamic Combat Encounters - Fight your way through enemy encounters with traditional formation combat and tactical grid based combat. Strategize your encounters to protect your team and get the upper hand.

Check Your Sanity - The more time you spend in the dungeons, the less sanity you have which can lead to more volatile encounters.

Meet Strange Characters - Find and befriend allies or make enemies within each dungeon for access to more loot, rewards, and information that will aid in your exploration of new areas.


Descent of Lunaris is a love letter to classic dungeon-crawling RPGs of the past. Descend into the depths and find the source of the signal that summoned your mission. Not everything is as it seems...

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


About Descent of Lunaris:

The year is 2070. A lunar mining operation picks up a mysterious signal emanating from the inside of the moon. Once the signal is discovered, all the automatons and electronic systems in the operation go haywire, killing a large portion of the base’s inhabitants.

A team of highly specialized operatives from all over the world are called in to investigate the disturbance and find the cause. What they discover through this journey into the unknown will change the course of human history.

As they descend through the world inside the moon they are confronted with twisted reflections of civilization, structures, and mythology we know to be our own. Are they being tested, or punished for the nature of humanity

Where will this descent take them, and what lies at the bottom?


Do you have what it takes to see what lies beneath?
